correctness.rationale: A two-consecutive-deleted-ancestor cut proves the exact two-type Galton–Watson genealogy. The scalar extinction map is strictly concave, with derivative \(R_m(p)=mp+m^2p(1-p)\), yielding the unique site threshold and extinction at criticality. A Fibonacci-type exact level recurrence gives susceptibility. Under finite second factorial moment, a second-order expansion at the critical fixed point yields the explicit positive survival slope. The checker performs 245892 finite exact enumeration/arithmetic assertions and two high-precision offspring-family diagnostics; these do not replace the infinite proof.
